_comment: Fine-grained admin permissions (Keycloak 26 FGAP v2) applied by scripts/realm/apply-admin-permissions.mjs, the second step of the realm import Job (keycloak-config-cli 6.5.1 cannot import them). Checked by scripts/ci/check-realm.mjs: Groups resource type only, non-staff groups only, scopes view-members and manage-members only, client policy on a registered service client only.

permissions.name: fbx-customers-customer-service
permissions.description: Customer service: view and update members of /customers only (identity link sets customer_id). Not staff users, no role or group changes.
permissions.reason: PUT /api/v1/customers/{id}/identity-link (staff step) reads the user and sets the attribute customer_id through the Keycloak admin API (GET and PUT /admin/realms/fintechbankx/users/{id}); confirmed by the customer thread 2026-10-08 (customer PR #13). Replaces realm-management manage-users (security review 2026-10-08, option A).
